message.content:
Brivaracetam is a pyrrolidone derivative (a racetam). As a finished oral solution in measured doses or retail packaging, it falls under heading 3004 (medicaments of mixed or unmixed products, put up in measured doses or retail packages).

Within 3004, the possible subheadings are:
- 3004.90: other medicaments.
- 3004.90.92 or 3004.90.91: statistical suffixes for other medicaments.

Brivaracetam is not an antibiotic, hormone, or alkaloid, so it falls under the residual "Other" at 3004.90. The 3004.90.92 line ("Other" within the group "Other") is the general residual for medicaments.

The HTS 3004.90 breakdown includes:
- 3004.90.10 (Antiasthmatics...)
- 3004.90.20 (Anesthetics?)
- 3004.90.60, 3004.90.71 (analgesics, antipyretics), 3004.90.91 (Other: Drugs for...), 3004.90.92 (Other).

Brivaracetam does not fit a more specific line, so I am choosing 3004.90.92.
